headline: Sony adds over 100 free TV channels to PlayStation 5 in the US
summary: PlayStation 5 owners can now stream ad-supported live TV channels directly from their console, with options for movies, anime, news, and more.
details: Sony is rolling out a new feature to PlayStation 5 consoles in the US that allows users to stream over 100 free, ad-supported live TV (FAST) channels directly from the console's media tab.

The new offering includes content from Sony Pictures Television, featuring channels dedicated to movies, TV shows, anime, news, sports, and documentaries. Popular shows like 'Community' and 'The Walking Dead,' as well as anime titles such as 'Naruto' and 'Sailor Moon,' will be available.
This move aims to keep users engaged within the PlayStation ecosystem and potentially generate additional revenue for Sony, aligning with their strategy of monetizing existing customers.
Sony plans to update the Live TV service with new programming and channels regularly and intends to expand the service to Canada and other regions in the future.
caption:
PlayStation 5 owners in the US can now stream over 100 free live TV channels directly from their console.

Sony is rolling out a new feature to PlayStation 5 consoles in the US that allows users to stream over 100 free, ad-supported live TV (FAST) channels directly from the console's media tab.

The new offering includes content from Sony Pictures Television, featuring channels dedicated to movies, TV shows, anime, news, sports, and documentaries. Popular shows like 'Community' and 'The Walking Dead,' as well as anime titles such as 'Naruto' and 'Sailor Moon,' will be available.

This move aims to keep users engaged within the PlayStation ecosystem and potentially generate additional revenue for Sony, aligning with their strategy of monetizing existing customers.

Sony plans to update the Live TV service with new programming and channels regularly and intends to expand the service to Canada and other regions in the future.
